tasks.short: Research funeral-service markets and analyse industry trends.

steps.what: Choose and read actual public funeral-service price lists, local demographic information and industry reports, checking dates and comparability
Discuss actual local service needs and referral experience with community contacts without using private bereavement details as research inputs
Prepare comparable service-package, price and period tables with explicit inclusions and exclusions
Analyse funeral-service trends and distinguish local demand evidence from noncomparable offers or anecdotes
Write and check the actual internal market note v1 with source references and uncertainty
Save the exact checked funeral-market note v1 in the same internal document store

tasks.design: Configure a native {SPREADSHEET} comparison template with separate service inclusions, dates and price units, plus a {DOCS} note template. The manager selects and reads actual sources, collects local observations and judges the trends; formulas and note structure remove only repeated assembly and layout.
tasks.previous_blocker: Different funeral packages and reporting periods make repeated comparison tables awkward.
tasks.enabler_now: Native structured tables and explicit units can repeat a defined comparison without deciding comparability.
tasks.still_hard: Published offers and community anecdotes may not describe actual local demand.
tasks.human_edge: Understand local customs and identify what a price comparison hides.

ambition.what: No automatic price or service changes.

tasks.altitude: Less comparison-table setup, with the same market judgement.

reach.learn: Distinguish permission-based local observations from unsupported demand claims.

evidence.claim: Native tables and document templates can reduce repeated market comparison and formatting work.

assumptions: Boundary is market research and the actual internal trend note, not service pricing or marketing execution. Shares describe a provisional mixed research task, not measured company activity.

Publishers produce actual dated price lists, package inclusions and industry statistics; contacts provide actual observations during s2. The manager manually reads, records and verifies source date, geography, period, units, package terms and limitations before comparison. Missing terms stay noncomparable, not inferred.

Try native templates first. Tables reuse checked entered fields; no web feed or automatic extraction is assumed. The 10% note reduction is layout/headings only, with actual interpretation and source checks full. Same-system save has no saving.
unknowns: Whether research includes community conversations and compatible sources
research_questions: Can a structured native table expose differences without adding more normalisation work than it removes?

already_counted.description: Check units, source periods and package comparability during table assembly.
Actual internal note and final source/meaning check.

incremental.description: Maintain comparison fields and note structure when service packages change.

approvals.approved_version: checked funeral-market note v1; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Recurring comparisons remove 10 table hours and 1.4 layout hours per provisional 100 task hours less 1 upkeep. Incomparable sources leave more manual work; source reading, conversations, trend judgement and save remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and implement funeral-home promotions and marketing activities.

steps.what: Choose a respectful funeral-home marketing objective, audience, service offer, budget and permitted channel
Prepare the service-information page or promotional copy for the chosen channel

loop.purpose: Draft factual, respectful service wording for the manager's chosen offer.
loop.input: Approved service descriptions, exact prices and inclusions, audience, channel and brief.
loop.output: Draft service page with source-linked factual claims.
loop.check: Manager checks tone, truthful inclusions/exclusions, price qualifications, availability and absence of invented testimonials or pressure on bereaved people.
loop.stop: One draft and correction; missing offers or unsupported claims return to manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Native page templates set layout but do not write suitable language for the specific approved offer.

steps.what: Check the exact completed funeral-service page v1, publication destination and truthful offer terms before public release
Publish the exact approved funeral-service page v1 to its named public website destination
Participate personally in the planned community information activity and answer actual service questions within the approved offer
Review actual page and enquiry counts and write/check the actual campaign outcome note v1 without attributing unproved effects
outputs: checked actual marketing outcome note v1

steps.what: Save the exact checked actual marketing outcome note v1 in the same document store
inputs: checked actual marketing outcome note v1
outputs: saved actual marketing outcome note v1

tasks.design: Use native {CMS} page templates and counters first, with a bounded copy draft from the manager's approved service brief in {DOCS}. The manager checks the complete public version before publishing and keeps community conversations human; native {CMS}/{CRM} count views reduce only result lookup, with actual interpretation and outcome recording retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Respectful service copy and repeated count lookup require preparation around each chosen activity.
tasks.enabler_now: Constrained drafting and existing count views can support that preparation without selecting the strategy.
tasks.still_hard: Trust, service suitability and honest offer terms require accountable human choices.
tasks.human_edge: Know when a message would be inappropriate for a bereaved audience and answer with care.

ambition.what: No automated targeting or spending rights.

tasks.altitude: Less copy drafting and counter navigation; strategy and community work stay human.

reach.learn: Check the exact offer, audience context and truthful claims before publication.

evidence.claim: Native page templates/counters and a reviewed factual copy draft can reduce marketing preparation; no measured funeral-home outcome is claimed.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is a service-information website activity plus personal community information work. Paid-ad buying, mass email and offers outside the approved scope require separate checked actions and are not credited. Shares are unmeasured task hypotheses.

Manager produces actual service capacity, exact prices/inclusions, chosen audience/channel and permitted offer; existing site counters produce actual page counts. Front-desk staff already produce actual dated enquiry records in {CRM}; missing source/channel labels are not inferred and manual checks remain. Community activity facts are captured by the manager in s5/s6.

Native configuration first. Only copy drafting and existing counter navigation shrink; result interpretation and note content remain full. No new tracking, family profiling or free sales baseline is assumed; ordinary publish and save time stays full.
unknowns: Actual marketing channel mix and existing counter coverage
Whether source-labelled enquiry records already exist
research_questions: Does reviewed copy drafting save effort while preserving exact terms and a suitable tone?

already_counted.description: Source and tone checks during copy preparation.
Actual result interpretation and checked outcome record.

incremental.description: Maintain copy constraints and native count-view definitions as offers change.

approvals.approved_version: approved funeral-service page v1 with exact terms and named public destination; changes void approval
checked actual marketing outcome note v1; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A factual service page removes 11.25 prose hours and native count views remove 2.1 navigation hours per provisional 100 task hours, less 1 upkeep. A sensitive novel message needs more manual writing; strategy, final review, publication, community conversations and save remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less repeated research assembly and copy drafting, with personal service judgement and community relationships unchanged.
reach: Use community communication practices without treating bereaved families as a profiling dataset.
role.ambitious_version: A funeral home manager with clearer checked information and unchanged publication, service and spending accountability.
